checks.check: Sled stack (sled, cage, spacers, switch, module envelopes) vs coupler bore
checks.evidence: 30.10 / 30.50 mm (CAD validation, PLACEHOLDER envelopes)

checks.check: Module / battery / GPS / switch envelopes vs structure (interference)
checks.evidence: no interference in the CAD validation

checks.check: Envelope completeness
checks.evidence: EL_modules() models MCU, IMU, barometer, microSD, LoRa only. Buzzer, status LED, regulator, temperature sensor, battery divider, connectors and wiring (all in the EL-AV mass or the interface list) have no envelope

checks.check: Real module dimensions vs placeholder envelopes
checks.evidence: no component selected; measure the selected boards (with headers and connectors) and update COTS_envelopes.scad

checks.check: Mounting bosses on sled / GPS tray / switch tower
checks.evidence: 10 / 6 / 1 M2.5 bosses (CAD validation); hole patterns of real boards unverified

checks.check: IMU position relative to the roll axis
checks.evidence: IMU envelope centre 20.5 mm off the axis (x -17.0, y 11.5 mm, beside the switch tower); the interface specification asks for near-axis mounting. Roll would add a centripetal reading of up to 6.3 m/s² at the 1000 deg/s gyro requirement. Roll rate is not simulated (1-DOF): decide the IMU position when the board is selected

checks.check: Barometer at the static-port station
checks.evidence: barometer envelope STA 522.5–535.5 mm; 4 × ⌀2 mm static ports at STA 529.0 mm (switch band)

checks.check: Avionics-bay sealing and static-port sizing
checks.evidence: gasket AV-309 and port size need a leak / pressure-lag bench test once a barometer has been selected

checks.check: GPS module under the service hatch
checks.evidence: GPS z 360-395, opening 381-409 (CAD validation)

checks.check: Battery envelope in the AV-308 cage
checks.evidence: BAT_W 28.0 <= 28.8 mm; cage vs battery envelope clear (CAD validation)

checks.check: Real cell size, strap retention, charging access
checks.evidence: placeholder cell 55 × 28 × 9 mm; retention needs a shake / drop check

checks.check: Harness pass-through AV-303 (I-08) and strain relief
checks.evidence: ⌀8 mm hole 14 mm off axis in AV-303; zip-tie slots on AV-306 (CAD sources)

checks.check: Connector passage through ⌀8 mm, wire count, bend radius, lengths
checks.evidence: no wiring is modelled; check with the selected connectors (keyed, per interface I-08)

checks.check: Radio envelope to GPS envelope separation
checks.evidence: 173 mm axially (radio STA 568–596, GPS STA 360–395), bulkhead AV-303 between them. RF interference needs a bench test

checks.check: Metal near the radio antenna
checks.evidence: M4 steel rods AV-305 (STA 436–628) run alongside the radio envelope; no antenna is modelled. Route the antenna away from the rods and battery; verify by range test (T-14)

checks.check: RF transparency of the airframe
checks.evidence: kraft / phenolic body tube assumed radio-transparent (no carbon fibre in the design); not measured

checks.check: Power switch reachable through the switch band
checks.evidence: 30.10 < 30.50 mm (CAD validation)

checks.check: Sled removal for SD card and battery service
checks.evidence: 30.10 < 30.50 (coupler bore): radial margin 0.40 mm on PLACEHOLDER envelopes (CAD feasibility check). Real boards, wires and connectors must keep this margin

checks.check: SD-card and battery-connector access without disassembly
checks.evidence: both sit inside the coupler; card-slot orientation and connector reach are not modelled

checks.check: CG analysis regenerated from analysis/results/mass_budget.csv
checks.evidence: recomputed M0 1210.7 g / CG STA 696.4 mm vs analysis 1210.7 g / 696.4 mm (budget masses are rounded to 0.1 g)

checks.check: Avionics / payload subtotal and its station
checks.evidence: 262.7 g at STA 472.4 mm (21.7 % of liftoff mass), forward of the liftoff CG (STA 696.4 mm)

checks.check: Liftoff static margin with assumed avionics masses +/-25% (illustrative band)
checks.evidence: 153.0 g assumed at STA 463.4 mm -> SM 2.52–2.74 cal (nominal 2.63; target 1.5–3.0). Includes the PLACEHOLDER motor mass

checks.check: Avionics, GPS, battery, camera and switch masses
checks.evidence: EL-GPS, EL-CAM, EL-AV, EL-BAT, AV-309/310 are estimates or placeholders: weigh the selected parts and update analysis/analysis.py through the normal pipeline
